SELECT c.biz_type, c.id, c.doc_no, c.doc_date FROM (
SELECT 'PUR_INSTOCK' AS biz_type, h.id, h.instock_no AS doc_no, h.instock_date AS doc_date FROM pur_instock h WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.status = 10 UNION ALL
SELECT 'PUR_RET', h.id, h.return_no, h.return_date FROM pur_return h WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.status = 10 UNION ALL
SELECT 'SAL_OUTSTOCK', h.id, h.out_no, h.out_date FROM sal_outstock h WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.status = 10 UNION ALL
SELECT 'SAL_RET', h.id, h.return_no, h.return_date FROM sal_return h WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.status = 10 UNION ALL
SELECT 'INVOICE_SALES', h.id, h.invoice_no, COALESCE(h.invoice_date, CURDATE()) FROM inv_sales_invoice h WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.status = 10 UNION ALL
SELECT 'INVOICE_PURCHASE', h.id, h.invoice_no, COALESCE(h.auth_date, h.invoice_date, CURDATE()) FROM inv_purchase_invoice h WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.status = 10 UNION ALL
SELECT 'RECEIPT', h.id, h.receipt_no, h.biz_date FROM fin_receipt h WHERE h.deleted = 0 UNION ALL
SELECT 'PAYMENT', h.id, h.payment_no, h.biz_date FROM fin_payment h WHERE h.deleted = 0 ) c WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_voucher v WHERE v.deleted = 0 AND v.book_id = #{bookId} AND v.source_type = c.biz_type AND v.source_id = c.id)
AND c.biz_type = #{bizType}
AND c.doc_date >= #{from}
AND c.doc_date <= #{to}
AND c.doc_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{daysBack} DAY)
ORDER BY c.doc_date, c.id LIMIT 500
SELECT id FROM fin_voucher WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND source_type = #{bizType} AND source_id = #{bizId} LIMIT 1
